definitions.explanation: The primary trunk route of a railway or highway, as distinguished from branch lines or side roads. Many Japanese railway lines include this word in their official names.

examples.japanese: {本線|ほんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{換|か}える→乗り換える：01194_norikaeru⟧。
examples.english: To transfer to the main line.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{東海道|とうかいどう}{本線|ほんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: This train runs on the Tokaido Main Line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高速|こうそく}{道路|どうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本線|ほんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合流|ごうりゅう}→合流：11902_gouryuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please watch your speed when merging onto the main highway.

notes:
Primarily used in railway terminology to distinguish the main trunk line from branch lines (⟦{支線|しせん}→支線：24370_shisen⟧). Many Japanese railway lines include {本線|ほんせん} in their official names (e.g., {東海道|とうかいどう}{本線|ほんせん}, ⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧{本線|ほんせん}). Also used for the main lanes of expressways.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {東海道|とうかいどう}{本線|ほんせん}: Tokaido Main Line
- ⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧{本線|ほんせん}: Chuo Main Line
- {本線|ほんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合流|ごうりゅう}→合流：11902_gouryuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to merge onto the main line/road
- {本線|ほんせん}⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧: on the main line

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{支線|しせん}→支線：24370_shisen⟧: branch line — a line branching off from the main line
- ⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧: route, line — a more general term for a train or bus route
